preamble: Lateralization of the alveolar sibilant [s] to the voiceless lateral fricative [ɬ]. In several southern Sinitic groups Middle Chinese *s- became [ɬ]: the Siyi and Gao-Yang Yue varieties (Taishanese, Yangjiang), Nanning Cantonese and Southern Pinghua, and, independently, Puxian Min of Fujian (三 'three' MC sam > Taishanese ɬam³³, Putian ɬɒ⁵³³; Guangzhou Cantonese keeps saam1).

examples.note: Puxian Min developed [ɬ] independently of Yue; Youyang has [θ] instead.
